question: JM 8 is related to FI 11 in a certain way. In the same way, LO 19 is related to HK 22. To which of the following is UX 27 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, JM 8 is related to FI 11

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e834faad3c5e7715e640933add2e1af0666bb5dc6efbceb79fd26818b3540844.png] 

For, LO 19 is related to HK 22

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bcace0b514e21c01a75692eafc7619efdac7eead4d0e2629d849e3c495dd0bd.png] 

Similarly, for **UX 27**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a69855a22405a50da9d96168664f8f09bcb54d3f958b0273cd176b4467ee20ef.png] 

So, UX 27 will be related to **QT 30** 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
